name: The Principal Source
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. Places are Classic’s, shown on the Forever maps. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
The Cliffspring Falls in Darkshore serves as the principal source of drinking water for the region, and now I suspect it is the principal source of the poison that is harming the local fauna - deer specifically.  Use this sampler to draw some water from the mouth of the cave; be careful, as dangerous naga now reside in a cave by the falls.

Once filled, deliver it to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine.  She is the one that requested our aid, and you will work with her to address this malady.
narrative.objectives:
Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls.

Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine, Darkshore.
narrative.offerRewardText:
By Elune, this water is disgusting! No wonder the deer are sick.

Something is polluting the water, and in turn corrupting Darkshore's entire water table. Sick deer have been seen all over area, and not just by the river. While this water is most likely a primary source of the sickness spreading, there's something else at work here.

This water, believe it or not, will help us formulate a cure. While I research this water, I have need of some items to formulate a cure...
narrative.requestItemsText:
You're the one that the Cenarion Circle in Moonglade sent? That's wonderful! We've quite the crisis our hands here regarding the poor deer, and we're happy for all the help we can get.

Do you have the sample of water that Dendrite Starblaze said you'd have? He notified me that you'd draw one so we could work on a cure together...

chain.subtitle: 5 quests at level 14, 3,325 XP in all.

quests.name: Lessons Anew
quests.objectiveText: Travel to Moonglade and speak with Dendrite Starblaze in the village of Nighthaven.

quests.name: The Principal Source
quests.objectiveText: Use the Empty Cliffspring Falls Sampler to draw a sample of water from the mouth of the cave by the falls. Deliver the Filled Cliffspring Falls Sampler to Alanndarian Nightsong

quests.name: Gathering the Cure
quests.objectiveText: Bring 5 Earthroot and 12 Lunar Funguses to Alanndarian Nightsong in Auberdine so she may make a curative salve.

quests.name: Curing the Sick
quests.objectiveText: Use the Curative Animal Salve on 10 Sickly Deer that are located throughout Darkshore; doing so should cure them.

quests.name: Power over Poison
quests.objectiveText: Return to Mathrengyl Bearwalker in the Cenarion Enclave, Darnassus.
